supportLevel: Unofficial public Microsoft Fabric status mirror based on HTML scraping

active.detailsHtml: Fabric customers using Oracle mirroring may find that data has stopped replicating to Fabric and may see stale data. The mirroring status still shows as Running and no errors appear. Engineers are investigating the issue and an update will be provided soon.
